description_en: Sets the secure phone number for a member of the resource account type
description_zh: 调用BindSecureMobilePhone为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码
name: BindSecureMobilePhone

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

You can call the [SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone](~~SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone~~) operation to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

您可以调用[SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone](~~SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone~~)获取验证码
parameters.name: verification_code

parameters.help_en:
The secure phone number.

The phone number must be the same as the phone number specified when you call the [SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone](~~SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone~~) operation to obtain the verification code.

Format: <Country code>-<Phone number>.

<props="china">
Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the `86-<Phone number>` format are supported.</props>


<props="intl">
Mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the `86-<Phone number>` format are not supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
安全手机号码。

该手机号码必须与[SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone](~~SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone~~)中获取验证码时设置的手机号码一致。

格式：<国家码>-<手机号码>。

<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>


<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>
parameters.name: secure_mobile_phone
